Nina (CSM): Heads-up: Voyager customer goes live Wed. Need a paste-ready one-paragraph + 5 tiny checklists for preflight, go-live, health checks, fallback, and renewal signals. Keep it very short so reps can email it.

Omar (CS Ops): Got it—I'll make five 1-2 line sections.

Tess (SRE): SRE tips: interactive batch wait <=20ms, background 100-200ms, fallback when queue_depth >200, route to quant-variant on GPU error.

Diego (Solutions Eng): I'll attach a minimal YAML and a one-liner curl they can run.

Omar (CS Ops): DRAFT (paste into kickoff email)
PRE-FLIGHT (48h): verify API keys & scopes; run 10 warm calls; seed top-10 prompt prefixes into cache; lock model version.
GO-LIVE (first 60m): interactive routes: max_wait_ms=20, max_tokens_per_batch=1024; background: max_wait_ms=150; enable prefix caching; start 10-15m warm pool.
HEALTH CHECKS (every 5m): P95 latency within SLA; error rate <1%; token throughput ~expected. If latency rises, reduce batch window or shift to lighter model.
FALLBACK (automated): if queue_depth>200 -> enable single-token streaming and reduce max_wait_ms; on OOM/gpu_failure -> route to next-compatible quantized model; send short customer notice: "Shifting to safe path, update in 15m."
RENEWAL SIGNALS (watch): usage drop >30% WoW after onboarding; repeated quality tickets; lack of engagement with enablement after 2 weeks -> CSM outreach.

Diego (Solutions Eng): YAML snippet for infra repo:
```yaml
routes:
  - name: interactive
    max_wait_ms: 20
    max_tokens_per_batch: 1024
    caching: prefix
  - name: background
    max_wait_ms: 150
    max_tokens_per_batch: 8192
fallbacks:
  - condition: queue_depth > 200
    action: enable_streaming_single_token
  - condition: gpu_failure
    action: route_to: model-quant-v2
```

Tess (SRE): Quick curl healthcheck the customer can run:
curl -H "Authorization: Bearer $REDWOOD_KEY" -d '{"input":"health-check","route":"interactive"}' https://api.redwood.example/v1/generate
Expect 200 + latency header.

Nina (CSM): Nice and tight. Add owners and two escalation contacts?

Omar (CS Ops): Owners: Nina (CSM) - customer comms; Diego (SE) - infra/config; Tess (SRE) - incidents. Escalation: pager oncall + support@redwood for 2nd line.

DeployBot: Deployment event: voyager-infra warm pool initialized at 1769991240.

Nina (CSM): Perfect, I'll paste this into the kickoff and request seed prompts today. Thanks all.
